headline: Sakayori Lab surges to fifth and enters ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Sakayori Lab gained 12.23 points to reach 81.81, rising from 20th to fifth in the past day and moving into the 17 gold places.
The gold line rose 2.78 to 72.92. Medals remain for the private standings to decide.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
